solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Hum overtures of Otello and Carmen backwards in box

indicators.note: backwards tells us the whole string built so far is read from right to left

parts.note: to hum is British slang for to smell bad, and a niff is a bad smell

indicators.note: overtures are openings, so the first letters of the two opera names are taken

explanation.surface: An opera lover hums the overtures of two Verdi and Bizet operas backwards, while sitting in a theatre box.
explanation.walkthrough: NIFF (a British word for a stink, like 'hum') plus O and C gives NIFFOC; 'backwards' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A coffin is the wooden box a body is buried in, so box is a loose synonym.

indicators.note: keeping means holding something inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: the CSE (Certificate of Secondary Education) was a British school qualification

indicators.note: headless means the first letter of the fruit is removed

parts.note: a tomato is botanically a fruit

explanation.surface: A certificate somehow involves a lifeless piece of fruit, as if a school exam were about a vegetable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'headless' removes the first letter. CSE, the Certificate of Secondary Education, was an English school exam until 1988.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in a coma is motionless and unresponsive, which is what inert means.

indicators.note: externally says the elaborate word lies outside, wrapping the home piece

parts.note: fancier means more ornate or elaborate
at home is in, so home gives IN

explanation.surface: A businessperson's house is fancier on the outside than the others.
explanation.definitionFit: A financier is a person who manages or invests large sums of money in business.

indicators.note: evenly says take the even-numbered letters, the second, fourth, sixth and eighth

explanation.surface: A gardening question: what villain would make a lilac bush grow evenly?
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of 'lilac grow' are I, A, G and O.
explanation.definitionFit: Iago is the scheming villain of Shakespeare's Othello, the very type of a stage villain.

clue.text: Put out by puritan collecting rubbish

indicators.note: collecting means gathering in, so one word takes in the other

parts.note: a prude is a prim, puritanical person
rot is nonsense or rubbish

explanation.surface: Someone is put out by a puritan who goes around collecting rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put out' reads as annoyed, but it means stick out.
explanation.definitionFit: To protrude is to stick out or project, which is one sense of the phrase put out.

indicators.note: included tells us the books go inside the other word

parts.note: to ration is to limit the supply of something
OT is the Old Testament, the standard crossword books

explanation.surface: A librarian decides to limit supply, with books included in the cutback.
explanation.definitionFit: Rotation is the act of turning round an axis, so it means turning as a noun.

clue.text: Hard, thuggish character interrupting solicitor from start to finish

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into the middle of the other word

parts.note: a tout solicits custom, so is a solicitor in that sense
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
a rough is a violent, thuggish person

explanation.surface: A hard thug keeps interrupting a lawyer from start to finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solicitor' looks like a lawyer, but here it is a tout, someone pushing for custom.
explanation.definitionFit: Throughout means all the way through, from the beginning right to the end.

parts.note: up means cheerful or in good spirits
a set is a social group or clique

explanation.surface: A cheerful in-crowd has become distressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Upset as an adjective describes someone troubled or unhappy, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Apply to seize power from master

indicators.note: to seize means to grab hold of, so the first word takes the second inside

parts.note: to exert force is to apply it
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Someone applies to take control away from their master.
explanation.definitionFit: A master of a craft is a skilled specialist, an authority in their field.

definitions.meaning: a monotonous hum or droning noise

explanation.definitionFit: Drone means both a monotonous humming noise and an unmanned aircraft, two separate senses.

parts.note: the Isle of Man in the Irish Sea

indicators.note: redistributed means shared out differently, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A company executive has the gear redistributed on an island site.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redistributed' makes AGER; in an across clue 'on' places it after the island.
explanation.definitionFit: A manager is an executive who runs a business or department.

indicators.note: inside says the vases are placed within the ram word

parts.note: a tup is a ram, a male sheep
urns are large vases

explanation.surface: Someone seems set on ramming vases inside something.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn up is to arrive or show up, so it means appears.

indicators.note: returning means going back, so the insect's name is read backwards

parts.note: a gnat is a small biting fly

explanation.surface: A gnat comes back for another bite.
explanation.definitionFit: Bite can mean a sharp, piquant flavour, and tang is such a strong taste.

clue.text: Tutor — maybe tutor in Royal Shakespeare Company?

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters could be arranged another way

parts.note: RSC is the usual abbreviation for the Royal Shakespeare Company

explanation.surface: Is a voice coach at the Royal Shakespeare Company perhaps a tutor?
explanation.walkthrough: TUTOR, IN and RSC give ten letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: An instructor is a teacher, and a tutor is another word for one.

clue.text: Yellow River dividing Switzerland from Thailand is receptacle for waste

indicators.note: dividing means splitting apart, so these pieces go between the two country codes

parts.note: CH is the international vehicle code for Switzerland
T is the international vehicle code for Thailand
amber is a yellowish-orange colour
the Po is Italy's longest river

explanation.surface: A yellow river flows between Switzerland and Thailand as a waste channel.
explanation.walkthrough: AMBERPO goes between CH and T.
explanation.definitionFit: A chamber pot is a bedroom bowl used as a toilet at night, a container for bodily waste.

definitions.meaning: a punning reading: visible is 'in sight', so the abbreviation L placed in the word for view

explanation.walkthrough: The second half is a cryptic reading, flagged by '?': L (left) in SIGHT, since visible means in sight.
explanation.definitionFit: A slight is a snub, a small insult shown through discourtesy or neglect.

clue.text: Lean and gaunt, initially, following number zero

indicators.note: following means coming after, so these pieces come after the number abbreviation

parts.note: thin means lean or slim

indicators.note: initially says take just the first letter of gaunt

explanation.surface: Someone lean and gaunt follows a diet with zero calories.
explanation.definitionFit: Zero is the figure for none at all, which is exactly what the word for no thing expresses.

indicators.note: reincarnated means reborn in a new form, so the letters take a new order

parts.note: the numeral four, spelt out
the numeral ten, spelt out

explanation.surface: A vampire comes back to life as two other answers in the grid.
explanation.walkthrough: '4, 10' looks like cross-references to other clues, but they are just numbers spelt out.
explanation.definitionFit: Nosferatu is the vampire of the 1922 German silent film, and the name is used for vampires generally.

indicators.note: put in means inserted, so is goes inside the shade word

parts.note: a nuance is a subtle shade of meaning or colour

explanation.surface: A pest is put in the shade.
explanation.definitionFit: A pest is an annoying person or thing, a troublesome irritant.

clue.text: Bird-lover turns to assistant for capital

indicators.note: turns means is turned round, so the lover's name reads backwards

parts.note: in Greek myth Leda was loved by Zeus in the form of a swan
an aide is an assistant

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher switches careers to become an assistant in a capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bird-lover' looks like a birdwatcher, but it is Leda, who was seduced by Zeus as a swan.
explanation.definitionFit: Adelaide is the capital city of the state of South Australia.

clue.text: Drink spread around by marine mammal

indicators.note: around means turned about, so the combined letters read backwards

parts.note: to sup is to drink
marg is short for margarine, a spread

explanation.surface: A drink spilt and spread around by a sea creature.
explanation.walkthrough: SUP and MARG together, read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Grampus is a name for Risso's dolphin and formerly for the orca, both sea-dwelling mammals.

clue.text: Returning from Hades, successor is obstinate

indicators.note: Returning says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Returning from the underworld, the heir proves stubborn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' marks the hidden letters, DESSUC, which 'Returning' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: Cussed means stubborn or awkward, describing someone obstinate; the 'is' completes the adjective phrase.

definitions.meaning: the final outcome or result of something
a lob is a shot hit high into the air

explanation.definitionFit: Upshot means the eventual result or outcome, and split in two it describes a lofted stroke.

definitions.meaning: belongings or miscellaneous items, as in all my things

explanation.definitionFit: Stuff means things or gear as a noun, and to cram tightly as a verb.

clue.text: Ruth maintains means to bind partners is inclination

indicators.note: maintains here means holds within, so the pity word wraps the others

parts.note: ruth is an old word for pity, surviving in ruthless
a rope is a means of tying things up
N and S, north and south, are partners at bridge

explanation.surface: Ruth insists that the way to tie couples together is a natural leaning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ruth' looks like a name, but it is the old noun meaning pity. ROPENS goes inside PITY.
explanation.definitionFit: A propensity is a natural tendency or leaning, an inclination to behave a certain way.

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O
to live is to exist, to be

explanation.surface: Being in love means being green, inexperienced and naive.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive is a shade of dull yellowish green, the colour of unripe olives.

definitions.meaning: fir or pine wood cut into planks
to do business, buy and sell

explanation.definitionFit: Deal is a word for softwood planks and also means to do business in goods.

indicators.note: some means a part of the next word, so the letters sit within it

explanation.surface: A song comes with a few variations on its theme.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo song in an opera or oratorio.

clue.text: Instrument protecting one in sharp turn

indicators.note: protecting means shielding by surrounding, so the instrument wraps the numeral

parts.note: a harp is a stringed musical instrument
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A musical instrument is shielded from damage as the van takes a sharp turn.
explanation.definitionFit: A hairpin bend is a very tight U-shaped curve in a road.

clue.text: Go wrong in service, backing one car manufacturer

indicators.note: in says the mistake word sits inside the other piece
backing means moving in reverse, so the service letters read backwards

parts.note: the RAF, the Royal Air Force, is one of the armed services
to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: A car breaks down in service, reversing into one supplied by its maker.
explanation.definitionFit: Ferrari is the Italian maker of sports cars, founded by Enzo Ferrari.

indicators.note: negotiated suggests something worked out and rearranged, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: The crossword setter claims to have negotiated international agreements.
explanation.definitionFit: Treaties are formal agreements between states, signed after negotiation.

clue.text: Greek character covered with horse dung

indicators.note: covered with means wrapped around, so the horse word surrounds the letter

parts.note: a mare is a female horse
nu is the thirteenth letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek man ends up covered with horse dung.
explanation.definitionFit: Manure is animal dung spread on fields as fertiliser.
